body_lead: Gandhinagar: For many job seekers, interviews remain the toughest stage of the recruitment process. Gujarat govt plans to change that with a free AI-powered platform that will conduct virtual mock interviews and offer personalised preparation for candidates seeking jobs in govt as well as private sectors. Officials say it is expected to improve employability while creating a statewide database of job aspirants. The platform, being developed by the state education department, is in the trial phase now and will be available through a web portal and a mobile application in a couple of months.
